Class HeadLockMark

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.HeadLockMark
final class HeadLockMark extends Object
The HeadLockMark class paints the head lock for one canvas card. The mark is a padlock image. An unlocked padlock is grey and the shackle is open. A locked padlock is green and the shackle is closed. The control sits at the far left of the card button bar, after the turn label. A divider sits between this control and the marks I, E, P, and O. This control is not one of those marks. It does not set aetheris.cellmark. It does not join the mark list. A left press is reported by the listener the card passes in. The card calls AetherisNotebookPanel to keep the packed prefix.

  • Method Details

    • control

      static JComponent control(boolean locked, MouseListener press)
      The method control builds the padlock for one card. The image is 16 by 16. The preferred size, the minimum size, and the maximum size are 16 by 16. The control does not take focus. The client property aetheris.headlock is true. The tip says the lock is separate from I, E, P, and O. The tip says a press keeps a packed prefix from the top of the deck. The tip says excluding a locked turn drops that lock. A non-null listener is added to the control.
      Parameters:
      locked - true when the shackle is closed and the ink is green
      press - the left-press listener, or null when the card adds none
      Returns:
      the padlock control

    • divider

      static JComponent divider()
      The method divider builds the line between the padlock and the marks. The line is one pixel wide. The component is 8 pixels wide and 16 pixels tall. The line is not a button and it does not take focus.
      Returns:
      the divider

    • image

      private static BufferedImage image(boolean locked)
      The method image paints the padlock into a clear image. A locked padlock uses the green ink. An unlocked padlock uses the grey ink. A hash in the row becomes that ink. A dot stays clear.
      Parameters:
      locked - true when the shackle is closed
      Returns:
      the 16 by 16 image
